transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because of... things I've been hearing at the shop. 

It's just... this man's voice. I keep hearing him coming from the garage vents, mostly. Or sometimes from right under the hood when I'm working. It's loud, like... as clear as somebody standing right next to me. He just tells me not to trust my husband... and not to touch certain cars. 

That's... that's it, really.
Aside from hearing this voice, have you been feeling unusually sad, hopeless, or perhaps abnormally energetic and impulsive lately?

Um... not sad. I guess... maybe energetic. Sometimes I just feel... I don't know, like I'm flying high. Like I could fix every car in town. 

But... then it shifts. If my husband asks why the dishes aren't done, or... if one of the techs moves my socket set... I just blow up. It feels like... like they're trying to hold me down or something. I don't know.
Are there times when you hear this voice even when you aren't feeling that 'flying high' energy or the irritability?

Yeah... I do. 

Like, there was a... a quieter few weeks a little while ago. I was just sleeping more. I wasn't really making any huge plans or anything. 

But... I still heard him. The voice in the garage. And... I still knew that my husband and my boss were tracking me. So... yeah. It doesn't stop.

Looking back over the entire time you've been experiencing these voices and the suspicion about your husband, would you say you've spent more time feeling 'flying high' or irritable, or more time feeling like your mood was mostly normal?

I guess... mostly the high energy. 

Almost the whole past year, really, it's just been... those stretches. Where I'm just... talking too fast, and I take on too many jobs at the shop. I just feel driven, I guess. Like I can't slow down, even if I wanted to.
During those times when your mood felt more normal, did the voices or the suspicion about your husband persist for at least two weeks without you feeling that high energy or irritability?

Yeah. Like I said before... there was that quieter time. Maybe... maybe three or four weeks? 

I wasn't feeling high or anything. Just... tired, mostly. Sleeping. But... the voice was still there. In the garage. And I still knew they were tracking me. It didn't go away just because I was tired.
During those times when your mood was lower and you felt tired, did you also experience feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or thoughts that life wasn't worth living?
No... I don't think so. I didn't feel guilty or anything like that. I was just... tired. Just wanted to sleep.

Looking back at the entire time you have been dealing with these voices and thoughts, would you say the periods where you felt that 'high energy' or irritability added up to more than half of the total time you've been sick?

Yeah, I guess so. Like I said, most of this past year has just been... taken over by those stretches. The high energy. Just... talking too fast and taking on too much work at the shop. Feeling like I can't slow down. So, yeah... definitely more than half the time.

During those times when you felt 'flying high' and were taking on too many jobs, did you ever reach a point where you were so energetic or impulsive that you couldn't function at your job, or had to be taken to the hospital because of your behavior?

Yeah... I guess it got pretty bad. 

I made some mistakes at the shop. They actually... they pulled me off the high-voltage EV work. Said they were worried I wasn't being safe. And... things at home were bad, too. We were fighting a lot. It got to the point where my husband... he ended up taking me in for an emergency evaluation.
